stepTitle: Is there a always unique solution to the optimal parameters $$\theta$$ that minimizes MSE for the model $$\hat{y}=f_\theta(x)=\theta_0+\theta_1x_1+\theta_2(8x_1-1)+\theta_3(3x_2+5)?$$
stepBody: We have a dataset $$\{(x_{i1},x_{i2},y_i)\}_{i=1}**n,$$ where features $$1$$ and $$2$$ are $$x_{i1},$$ $$x_{i2}$$ and the target is $$y_i.$$
